name: Ankora
source:
"Things will be different this time..."

Ankora is a cheery and optimistic person, but for a love demon, she's surprisingly uncharismatic. Always tries to see the best in everyone, even her enemies. A huge people person and gets depressed if left alone for too long. A little bit of a pervert.

[From [url=https://lovelandisle.itch.io/love-in-a-bottle]itch.io[/url]]
